result.topic_en: Calculations on a first-order differential relation involving the quantity $\sqrt{\omega^2/(\varrho\varrho_1)-1}$, introducing an integrating factor $\Omega$ and a potential-like function $w$ of variables $r,s$, leading to a second-order partial differential equation for $w$ (apparently related to gas dynamics / characteristics).
result.transcription:
$\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1}\,dr = \left(x\left(u-v\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1}\right)+y\left(v+u\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1}\right)\right)dr + \left(x\left(u+v\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1}\right)+y\left(v-u\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1}\right)\right)ds$
$\left(v+\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1}\,u\right)\frac{\partial r}{\partial x} = \left(u-v\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1}\right)\frac{\partial r}{\partial y}$
$\frac{\partial r}{\partial x} = \Omega\left(u-v\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1}\right)$
$dr = \Omega\left(\left(u-v\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1}\right)dx + \left(v+u\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1}\right)dy\right)$
$= \Omega\left( d\left(\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho}-1}\,\frac{\partial w}{\partial r}\right) + dw + (x\,dv-y\,du)\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1} + (xv-uy)\,d\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho}-1}\right)$
{+[-$\frac{\partial w}{\partial s}(-ds$-]+}
$=\Omega\left(\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1}\,d\frac{\partial w}{\partial r} + \frac12\left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial r}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial s}\right)\left(d\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1} + \frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}ds\right) - 2\frac{\partial w}{\partial r}dr\right)$
$\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1}\,\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial r\partial s} + \frac12\left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial r}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial s}\right)\left(\frac{\partial\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1}}{\partial\log\omega\,\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1}} - \frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}\right)=0$
$\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1} = -\frac{\partial\log\varrho}{\partial\log\omega}$
$\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1 = -\frac{\partial\log(\varrho\omega)}{\partial\log\omega}$
$\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1}\,\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial r\partial s} + \frac12\frac{\partial\log\left(\varrho\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1}\right)}{\partial\log\omega}\left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial r}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial s}\right)=0$
$\left(u-v\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1}\right)\frac{\partial r}{\partial x} = \left(\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1}\right)\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial r^2}$
$\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho}-1}\,dr = \left(x\omega\left(\cos\sigma-\sin\sigma\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1}\right)+y\omega\left(\sin\sigma+\cos\sigma\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho}-1}\right)\right)dr +$

[right column]
$x\,dv-y\,du = \partial\log\omega\,(xv-uy) + d\sigma\,(xu+yv)$
$= -\frac{\partial w}{\partial\sigma}\partial\log\omega + \frac{\partial w}{\partial\log\omega}d\sigma$
[-$dw = \frac{\partial w}{\partial\sigma}d\sigma + \frac{\partial w}{\partial\log\omega}d\log\omega$-]
[-$\left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial\sigma}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial\log\omega}\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1}\right)dr$-]
$dw = \frac{\partial w}{\partial r}dr + \frac{\partial w}{\partial s}ds$
$=$
$2(x\,dv-y\,du) = \left(-\frac{\partial w}{\partial r}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial s}\right)\partial\log\omega + \left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial r}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial s}\right)d\sigma\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1}$
$2(x\,dv-y\,du)\sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}-1} = -2\frac{\partial w}{\partial r}dr + 2\frac{\partial w}{\partial s}ds + \left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial r}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial s}\right)[-$dr-ds$-]\,\frac{\partial}{\partial r}[?]\frac{\omega^2}{\varrho\varrho_1}$
$xv-uy = [-2-]\,-\frac{\partial w}{\partial\sigma} = -\frac12\frac{\partial w}{\partial r}+\frac12\frac{\partial w}{\partial s}$
